# Test-validity proof-pack certification

This corpus binds one complete passing witness and one independent weakening for
every guarantee axis. The executable test constructs the witness from the v0.3
controlled-contract vocabulary and verifies that every weakening is rejected by
its declared diagnostic. The result is planning evidence only and performs no
semantic judgment about the coordinator-authored boundary, observable, or
provider choice. Provider controls independently reject missing, unknown,
stale, capability-incompatible, incomplete, caller-injected, falsely supported,
and wrong-snapshot execution mechanisms. Launcher-observation controls also
reject printed reason or traversal claims, echoed launcher inputs, inert or
unrelated mutations, a wrong structured failure reason, missing V8
instrumentation, forged artifacts, and provider strategy or boundary mismatches.
